description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Awoken Spellblade], [Damage Cap +10000], [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [Path of Flame Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Awoken Spellblade
description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next attack

description.name: Path of Flame Mode
description.text: Casts Master Pyroblade when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering two times
